sa1063 swissgear laptop backpack - gray.name: SA1063 Swissgear Laptop Backpack - Gray
sa1063 swissgear laptop backpack - gray.description: Designed for busy days and heavier tech loads, the SWISSGEAR 1063 Laptop Backpack keeps your essentials protected and organized for work, school, or travel. A padded, felt-lined laptop pocket securely fits laptops up to 17”, while a dedicated padded tablet pocket accommodates tablets up to 11” x 8”. The spacious main compartment provides room for books, files, and daily gear, featuring a file pocket, a zippered laminated pocket, and a zippered mesh pocket to keep everything neatly in place.  For easy access and everyday convenience, the backpack includes a small front quick-access pocket and a larger front organizer pocket with eleastic pen loops and a metal clip key or fob lanyard.  Two elastic,expandable side pockets hold water bottles or accessories, while an add-a-bag trolley strap makes travel effortless.  Comfort is built in with a padded mesh back panel and contoured shoulder straps with suspended plastic D-rings, delivering breathable support and functional carry wherever the day takes you.

signorina — set de regalo para mujer.description: Signorina belongs to the elusive range of perfumes from Salvatore Ferragamo and was launched in 2011. A fresh and elegant perfume, Signorina has tantalising layers of notes, currant with pink pepper, jasmine with peony and rose followed by panaccotta, musk and patchouli. A heady mix, Signorina hints at the allure of the young woman in you and subtly enhances your youthful charm.
